name: goldnead/statamic-accounts
description: Accounts for Statamic: email verification, email change with confirmation, account deletion with a grace period, a personal data export every addon contributes to, and a customer overview in the Control Panel.

suggest.ext-zip: Delivers the personal data export as a ZIP with one JSON file per addon. Without it the export is a single JSON file.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-brand-context: Makes the grace period, link lifetimes and mail templates editable per brand under Settings.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-email-templates: Lets editors write every account mail in the Control Panel.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-activity: Records verifications, email changes, deletions, exports and impersonations in the activity ledger.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-identity-contracts: Attributes everything done while impersonating to the customer, with the admin named alongside.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-automations: Adds every account event as an automation trigger.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-webhook-manager: Adds every account event as a webhook trigger.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-payments: Payments and subscriptions in the customer overview and the data export.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-entitlements: Access grants in the customer overview and the data export.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-leadhub: The CRM contact in the customer overview and the data export.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-notifications: Notifications and preferences in the data export.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-teams: Team memberships in the customer overview and the data export.
